1//! Ported from <https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/src/core/crypto.js>.
2
3use alloc::vec;
4use alloc::vec::Vec;
5
6#[derive(Clone)]
7pub(crate) struct Rc4 {
8    a: u8,
9    b: u8,
10    s: [u8; 256],
11}
12
13impl Rc4 {
14    pub(crate) fn new(key: &[u8]) -> Self {
15        let mut s = [0_u8; 256];
16        let key_length = key.len();
17
18        for (i, s) in s.iter_mut().enumerate() {
19            *s = i as u8;
20        }
21
22        let mut j = 0_u8;
23        for i in 0..256 {
24            let tmp = s[i];
25            j = j.wrapping_add(tmp).wrapping_add(key[i % key_length]);
26            s[i] = s[j as usize];
27            s[j as usize] = tmp;
28        }
29
30        Self { a: 0, b: 0, s }
31    }
32
33    pub(crate) fn decrypt(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
34        let n = data.len();
35        let mut output = vec![0_u8; n];
36
37        for i in 0..n {
38            self.a = self.a.wrapping_add(1);
39            let tmp = self.s[self.a as usize];
40            self.b = self.b.wrapping_add(tmp);
41            let tmp2 = self.s[self.b as usize];
42            self.s[self.a as usize] = tmp2;
43            self.s[self.b as usize] = tmp;
44            output[i] = data[i] ^ self.s[tmp.wrapping_add(tmp2) as usize];
45        }
46
47        output
48    }
49
50    pub(crate) fn encrypt(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
51        self.decrypt(data)
52    }
53}

55#[cfg(any())]
56mod rc4_tests {
57    use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::crypto::rc4::Rc4;
58
59    fn rc4_decrypt(key: &[u8], input: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
60        let mut cipher = Rc4::new(key);
61        cipher.decrypt(input)
62    }
63
64    #[cfg(any())]
65    fn correctness() {
66        assert_eq!(rc4_decrypt(b"a", &[0x68]), b"x");
67        assert_eq!(rc4_decrypt(b"key", &[0x7F, 0x09, 0x47, 0x99]), b"test");
68        assert_eq!(rc4_decrypt(b"hello", &[0x78, 0x3E, 0xCD, 0x96, 0xCF]), b"world");
69        assert_eq!(rc4_decrypt(b"\x01\x02", &[0x0C, 0x74, 0xB9]), b"Hi!");
70        assert_eq!(rc4_decrypt(b"secret", &[0x80, 0x45, 0xB5]), b"msg");
71
72        assert_eq!(rc4_decrypt(b"encryption", &[0x8A, 0x36, 0x3F, 0x85, 0xDB, 0x9A, 0x62, 0x7C, 0x6C, 0x56, 0x81, 0x89]), b"Hello World!");
73        assert_eq!(
74            rc4_decrypt(
75                b"my_secret_key",
76                &[0x1D, 0xE2, 0xCE, 0x64, 0x4C, 0x88, 0x1C, 0x42, 0x7D, 0x94, 0x7B, 0x1C, 0x49, 0xCD, 0x62, 0x3F, 0xCA, 0x90, 0x99]
77            ),
78            b"The quick brown fox"
79        );
80        assert_eq!(
81            rc4_decrypt(
82                b"abcdefghijklmnop",
83                &[0xF8, 0xA8, 0x2A, 0xAE, 0x92, 0x2F, 0x8C, 0x3B, 0x13, 0xC7, 0x4B, 0x99, 0xDB, 0x41, 0x2C, 0x9F, 0x92, 0x59, 0xC2, 0xE5, 0x62, 0x2C]
84            ),
85            b"This is a test message"
86        );
87        assert_eq!(
88            rc4_decrypt(
89                b"password123",
90                &[0xDB, 0xC3, 0xA3, 0x21, 0x7E, 0x55, 0x0B, 0x65, 0xA2, 0x3F, 0x0E, 0xB7, 0x58, 0x7C, 0x28, 0xEE, 0xD6, 0x92, 0x05, 0xBC, 0x6C]
91            ),
92            b"Decryption successful"
93        );
94        assert_eq!(
95            rc4_decrypt(
96                b"very_long_key",
97                &[
98                    0xC6, 0xD2, 0x00, 0x3B, 0x8C, 0x18, 0x49, 0x2C, 0xD0, 0x5C, 0x8A, 0x34, 0xEC, 0xFE, 0xED, 0x62, 0xC0, 0x3C, 0x80, 0x81, 0x7E,
99                    0x4E, 0xE1, 0x7D, 0xBD
100                ]
101            ),
102            b"PDF uses RC4 for security"
103        );
104    }
105}
